detail:
New decision "Auto-archive trigger counts only archivable entries (excludes decision cross-posts and archive-tagged summaries) and the archiver's summary post carries _skipAutoArchive" relates to:
- 01KQ09TCGSFY75732ZAEN7WHZF: "Default tool surface is 5 core tools gated behind full_surface flag"
- 01KQ0VBWP8703Z0T675AZ1KHYS: "Prefer explicit Rationale:/Why:/Reason:/Because: markers over heuristic split separators in record-parser"
- 01KQ0VBWQPD1ND8SKA7TR2X04X: "Replaced split(regex, 2) with single-split-on-first-match that preserves the full remainder"
- 01KQ0VBWS51Z5B7B0FNFY3RDEN: "Added a structured union variant to twining_record's decisions field: each item is either a string (NL path) or an object { summary, rationale?, alternatives?, assumptions?, constraints?, confidence?, context?, domain? }. When structured, the parser is bypassed entirely, guaranteeing exact round-trip. Alternative rejected: separate twining_record_structured tool (doubles the tool surface, splits documentation). Alternative rejected: always-parse NL (cannot handle long multi-paragraph rationales reliably)."
- 01KQ0VBWT08012C3H6PYHFNC0A: "Sliced decision cross-post summary to 200 chars and wrapped in try/catch inside DecisionEngine.decide"
- 01KQ0VBWWEXR62BG3MYGE79FB7: "Surfaced per-decision persistence errors in the twining_record response"
- 01KQWE98F42J3FJKQW1Q6T0PFF: "Staleness threshold is global-only (config.yml housekeeping.staleness_threshold, default 0.95). Per-decision sunset overrides not added"
- 01KQWF4YTD4ZZ0WKVV61V77KV6: "Used null sentinel from listLocalBranches() to distinguish 'enumeration failed' from 'legitimately empty branch set'"
- 01KWN4BCJVKH1X982JA0WDDS66: "Forward migrate refuses to run when config is sqlite with export_records explicitly false"
summary: Related decisions in scope: 9 existing decision(s) overlap
